title: Siege of Buda (1684)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Buda (1684)", at revision 1370739850, opens: "The siege of Buda was a siege by the Holy Roman Empire of the Ottoman fortress of Buda. After 109 days, the siege was abandoned." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3625456, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1684 siege in the Great Turkish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
